pick.headline: Romanian security forces fire on protesters in Timisoara
pick.summary: On 17 December 1989 Romanian army and Securitate forces opened fire on demonstrators in Timisoara, where protests had begun over the attempted eviction of the pastor Laszlo Tokes.
pick.significance: The massacre set off the revolution that overthrew Nicolae Ceausescu within a week.

alternates.headline: Fernando Collor elected president of Brazil
alternates.summary: On 17 December 1989 Fernando Collor de Mello defeated Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in Brazil's first direct presidential election since 1960.
alternates.significance: Collor's election completed Brazil's return to democracy; he was impeached three years later.
